create_VideoManager: create a VideoManager instance with a config to read frames from a webcam or video file sequentially
iterate_VideoManager_next: iterate over a VideoManager to get clips of frames as TaskInfo objects for video inference
create_ThreadVideoManager: create a ThreadVideoManager instance with a config to read and write video frames using multithreading
start_ThreadVideoManager_threads: start the read and display threads on a ThreadVideoManager for concurrent frame processing
display_VideoManager_task: display visualized frames from a TaskInfo object to a window or write them to an output video file
